answer.summary: Two architecture tests fail deterministically on code this change added. AssetGroupService.assetGroupsOfAssets calls its own @Transactional method assetGroupIdsByAssetId (AssetGroupService.java:331), which bypasses the Spring proxy, and LinkedIdResolutionArchTest reports the new AssetGroupRepository lookup as an undeclared id-resolution site. The rest of the run passed, and the JSON parse error at line 1247 is logged noise, not the cause. Fix the self-invocation and the id-resolution pattern, or declare the site in the baseline, then re-run.
